audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice in this matchup and there was none: dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were all generic filler carrying no ability, no number and no interaction. wants.you[1] also told the player to W 'during his Soul Unbound windup', which is not a thing in the kit — there is no windup, the spirit simply leaves the body behind.
audit.why: Soul Unbound (22/19/16/13/10s) leaves Yone's body behind and, when it ends, repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit — so damage he takes while the soul is out lands on the body, and the snap-back is the punish window.
